summary: Coeur d'Alene NF lookout: camp 1930, 30-foot L-4 pole tower 1934, destroyed about 1960; cement footings and debris remain.

facts.design: 30-foot pole tower with an L-4 cab
facts.status_note: Tower destroyed about 1960; cement footings and debris remain at the site

access.note: Hike-in site on Coeur d'Alene National Forest land; the sources read mention no closure or permit, but none says outright that the site is open to the public

visit.trail_note: Hike-in; Idaho Fire Lookouts calls the hike beautiful and easy to follow

events.note: 30-foot pole tower with an L-4 cab
Duncan McClean named as lookout in a Wallace Press-Times item dated 06/07/1934
Walter Edelbute named as lookout in a Wallace Press-Times item dated 06/25/1935
Julius Larson listed as lookout on Idaho Fire Lookouts (no newspaper cited)
Gerald Cox listed as lookout on Idaho Fire Lookouts under 1940 (Wallace-Press Times item)
Lookout called in because of rain and cool weather, per a Spokane Chronicle item quoted by Forest Lookouts (September 4, 1936)
Tower destroyed; Forest Lookouts gives c.1960
Registered March 24, 2020; nominated by Tom Taylor

resolved_conflicts.explanation: firelookout.com and Idaho Fire Lookouts give 1960; Forest Lookouts gives c.1960 from a source it names Kresek. Treated as the same date.

notes_for_editor: The brief's record checks out on county, coordinates, elevation (5,228 ft), built 1934, destruction around 1960 and the 2020 registration. The brief listed access as unknown, and I have kept it that way: the sources mention a hike-in on national forest land with no closure, but none says outright that the site is open, so check before publishing. The 30-foot height comes from firelookout.com and the Forest Lookouts page; the register gives no height. Idaho Fire Lookouts' staff list shows 1934 (McClean), 1935 (Edelbute), 1937 (Larson) and 1940 (Cox); the story and events now follow that list, and the earlier Cox-1935 entry was wrong. The register page has a photo credited to Tom Taylor ('Remains of tower leg'); I did not fetch its image URL or license, so no photo entry.
